simple.meaning: קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת (qasqeseth) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 11:9. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת (H7193) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת (qasqeseth) / H7193 is traced through Leviticus 11:9, Leviticus 11:10, Leviticus 11:12, Deuteronomy 14:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: a scale (of a fish); hence a coat of mail (as composed of or covered with jointed plates of metal)

firstOccurrence.englishText: “ ‘These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

timeline.evidenceText: “ ‘These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.
All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.
These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels† A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 5000 shekels is about 50 kilograms or 110 pounds. of bronze.
I will put hooks in your jaws,
I will put hooks in your jaws,

(Lexicons), ᵑ7 Jer i. Num 11:4 plural קַטַּיָּיא ( ט for ת after ק ); Greek σίκυος σικύη Lag Arm. Stud. § 1975; M ii. 356 Lewy Fremdw. 30 ).
